meta.title: Lost Umbrella
meta.logline: A delivery robot returns a lost umbrella before its owner gets wet.

brief.message: Lost things come home the same day.
brief.cta: Try it on your next commute.

theme.style: Warm stop-motion claymation look, handmade miniature sets, symmetrical framing, soft 35mm grain, rainy-city pastels, golden practical lights.
theme.negative: No readable brand names or logos

cast.name: JUNE
cast.anchor: woman in her 30s, short grey bob, green raincoat, red umbrella with a white handle

cast.name: PIP
cast.anchor: small round delivery robot with one blue eye and an orange flag

story.arc: June leaves her umbrella on a tram. Pip finds it, works out whose it is, and brings it to her bus stop before the rain gets worse.

setupsPayoffs.what: The red umbrella left on the seat is the one June opens at the end.

shots.title: Left behind
shots.action: June runs off a tram. Her red umbrella stays on the seat.
shots.vo: Every day, a million umbrellas go missing.

prompts.still: Wide shot of a pastel tram interior in the rain. JUNE hurries out of the doors; her red umbrella lies on the empty seat.
prompts.motion: The doors close; the tram pulls away; the umbrella slides on the seat.

shots.title: Pip finds it
shots.action: Pip scans the seat, tags the umbrella and sets off through the rain.

prompts.still: Close shot of PIP rolling up to the tram seat, its blue eye scanning the red umbrella with a soft light.
prompts.motion: Pip's eye scans, a small chime, Pip lifts the umbrella onto its back.

shots.title: Reunited
shots.action: Pip finds June at a bus stop and hands back the umbrella.

prompts.still: JUNE at a rainy bus stop, surprised and smiling as PIP holds up her red umbrella.
prompts.motion: June takes the umbrella and opens it over both of them.
